additional_medicare.note: IRC 3101(b)(2) / 3102(f): 0.9% on Medicare wages over the filing-status threshold; employers withhold the extra 0.9% per earner only on wages over $200,000. Thresholds statutory, not inflation-indexed.

source: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32 (IR-2025-103, 2025-10-09), incl. OBBBA standard-deduction enhancement; NIIT thresholds are statutory (IRC 1411, not inflation-indexed)
status: VERIFIED 2026-11-07 against Rev. Proc. 2025-32 figures as published by IRS and cross-checked across three independent summaries. Supersedes version 2026.0-estimated, whose prototype constants proved materially off (e.g. MFJ standard deduction 30,750 vs official 32,200; every bracket threshold differed).
